questions.text: What do you sell today, and to whom?
questions.followUp: Name the exact service and exactly who buys it today, for example 'we build WhatsApp booking bots for clinic and salon owners in Pune'.

questions.text: Think of your best past customers. What did they buy, and why did they buy it?
questions.followUp: Describe one or two real past customers: what they bought and the reason they said yes. If details do not come to mind, describe what kind of customer it was.

questions.text: List the services you deliver.
questions.followUp: List each service on its own line, for example 'website' or 'WhatsApp automation'.

questions.text: How long does a typical delivery take, from start to handover?
questions.followUp: Give a rough duration such as '1-2 weeks' or '3 days'.

questions.text: What is your price range? Write it in INR or your own currency, exactly as you quote it.
questions.followUp: Write the actual range as you quote it, with the currency, for example '20,000 to 60,000 INR per month'.

questions.text: What proof can you show a prospect: results, testimonials, past work, portfolio?
questions.followUp: Write anything a prospect can check: an example, a testimonial, a demo. Write 'none yet' if there is nothing.

questions.text: Which target industry do you want to sell into?
questions.followUp: Name the industry, for example dental clinics, salons, gyms or travel agencies.

questions.text: Narrow it to a sub-niche: the exact kind of business you want.
questions.followUp: Be specific: 'dental clinics that do implants' or 'gyms in tier-2 cities', not just 'clinics'.

questions.text: How many staff does a typical target business have?
questions.followUp: A rough number is fine, for example 5.

questions.text: How many years has a typical target business been operating?
questions.followUp: A rough number of years is fine, for example 3.

questions.text: How many locations or branches does a typical target business have?
questions.followUp: Enter 1 for a single-location business.

questions.text: What is the typical ticket size of what the target business sells?
questions.followUp: Write it as they might quote it, for example 'about 500 INR per visit' or '40,000 INR per case'.

questions.text: What level of online presence do your target businesses have today?
options: active website plus ads and social pages
questions.followUp: Pick the level that fits most of your target businesses.

questions.text: Which country should the search cover?
questions.followUp: Name one primary country, for example India.

questions.text: Which state or states, if it matters?
questions.followUp: Leave blank if the state does not matter.

questions.text: Which cities should be searched? List them one per line, or give one city plus a radius.
questions.followUp: One city per line. If you prefer an area instead, write one city plus a radius, for example 'Pune, 30 km'.

questions.text: Which languages should outreach use?
questions.followUp: One language per line, for example 'English' or 'Hindi'.

questions.text: Which pain triggers or buying signals should the matching look for?
questions.followUp: Pick at least one trigger you want us to watch for.

questions.text: Any other trigger worth watching, in your own words?
questions.followUp: Describe it plainly, for example 'clinics that pay for ads but do not reply to enquiries'.

questions.text: Who makes the buying decision at these businesses?
questions.followUp: Pick the person who usually signs off on something like this. If it varies, pick the most common case.

questions.text: Who else decides? Describe the role.
questions.followUp: Name the role, for example 'receptionist' or 'franchise head office'.

questions.text: How can we best reach the decision maker?
questions.followUp: Name a concrete channel such as phone, WhatsApp or email, and any detail you know about reaching them.

questions.text: What should be excluded from the results: chains, competitors, already-served businesses, categories to avoid?
questions.followUp: One exclusion per line, for example 'chains' or 'businesses we already serve'. Write 'none' if there are truly none.

questions.text: How many new leads do you want per week?
questions.followUp: Give a number of new leads per week, for example 25.

questions.text: How many of those can you realistically contact per week?
questions.followUp: Be honest about what you can realistically contact in a week, for example 10.

questions.text: Which outreach channels should be used?
questions.followUp: Pick every channel you want us to use. Anything left unticked will not be used.

questions.text: What tone should the outreach have?
questions.followUp: Pick the tone that matches how you talk to customers.

questions.text: Anything outreach must always mention, or must never mention?
questions.followUp: Write any must-say or must-avoid points, for example 'always mention free first call' or 'never mention competitor names'.

questions.text: Give 3 to 5 example websites of ideal customers, one address per line.
questions.followUp: Paste 3 to 5 website addresses of businesses you would call a perfect customer, one per line. If you have no exact examples, paste addresses of prospects you have seen recently.
